Name: AT Portal Cats
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Retextures of the four warp obelisks to look like cats (Water, Earth, Island, and Desert). For the Farm Obelisk, you can use this mod I made: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13319]CP Farm Portal Cat[/url]

Now has textures for the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787] East Scarp[/url] obelisk (thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24986819]Gervig91[/url] for letting me use your pelican assets) and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] obelisk (thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url] for letting me use the Foxbloom).

Added a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Zuzu[/url] Obelisk! Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/111722573]XxHarvzBackxX[/url] for letting me use your Zuzu Signature Cocktail.

Added a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]DeepWoods[/url] obelisk!

Downloads.Description: Retextures of the warp obelisks for AT. Added warp obelisks for RSV, ES, Zuzu, and DeepWoods.
